propositions: Rebar must delegate authentication to provider-native SDKs and helpers rather than implementing a universal secret broker or credential store
Operation snapshots must remain non-secret and unable to contain raw credential values or whole constructed clients
Static credentials rotate only through process restart or container redeploy; no hot-reload or polling is supported

Deployment resolves external secret stores before startup and supplies secrets via REBAR_OPCERT_KEY_PATH or REBAR_OPCERT_PRIVATE_KEY environment variable; no runtime boto3 or cloud-secret retrieval occurs in the application
Rebar child processes inherit ambient environment but remove only exact sibling adapter secret names and overlay static values only onto their owning child; no global os.environ mutation occurs
Provider-specific non-serializable containers using Pydantic SecretStr wrap unavoidable static credentials with fields excluded from repr, comparison, hashing, and fingerprints
